_doc: Per showcased class: `skip` (with the reason) leaves it out of rxap.figcraft; `open` ({action: click|hover|contextmenu|focus, selector, overlayOnly?, variants?}) captures its opened surface as an extra state `open`. `maxDiff` (share of differing pixels, 0..1) overrides `defaults.maxDiff` for the visual check. `minPixels` (default in `defaults`): a variant fails the visual check only with more differing pixels than this. `viewport` ({width, height}): render a full-screen layout at this window size instead of growing the window to its content.

UserProfileIconComponent.reason: An unstyled native <button> (the styleguide has no Tailwind preflight): FigCraft draws Chrome's light button look, Chrome turns it dark in the dark scheme.

PreventDefaultDirective.reason: An unstyled link: its colour is the browser's link colour (a CSS system colour without a Material token), which Chrome changes in the dark scheme.

OptionsCellComponent.reason: Short label: glyph drift between Chrome and FigCraft.
